name: Shirayuki
source:
The protagonist of one of the Grimms' Fairy Tales, "Snow White".

She believes that she is the most beautiful girl in the world and takes it for granted. However, this is because she doesn't know anything about the outside world. In other words, she is just naive.

She's not happy unless she's the best at being "pretty" and "beautiful". When she's not, she can be pretty dramatic. Other than that, she's an airhead who can easily be influenced, believing everything she's been told. All that said, those are just the results of her innocence, and at heart she's a straightforward and loveable girl.

"The most beautiful girl in the world, Shirayuki, is here! Please let me see your face, my prince—!"

[Edited from [url=http://yumemiru.nexton-net.jp/gbm-grimm/episode01/#character]Official Website[/url]]
